title: AI Systems Platform
description: A multi-layered AI system platform integrating three major AI-driven subsystems into a single architecture: a public-facing RAG chatbot, an admin-level business intelligence copilot, and an AI-powered blog generation system.

highlights.heading: RAG Chatbot System
points: Full RAG-based system — not a simple LLM wrapper
Flow: User Query → Embedding Generation → Vector Search (pgvector) → Context Injection → LLM Response
Multi-turn conversation memory + lead capture system integrated

highlights.heading: Multi-Provider LLM Architecture
points: Primary → OpenAI, Secondary fallback → Gemini, Final fallback → Groq
Ensures high availability even if one provider fails

highlights.heading: Admin AI Copilot
points: Injects live business data into AI context from contacts, invoices, blogs
Revenue analysis, lead prioritization, blog performance insights

title: Enterprise Website + Admin SaaS Platform
description: A complete enterprise-grade SaaS platform consisting of a public website (15+ pages) and an admin dashboard (24+ pages), designed to handle real business operations — not just presentation.

highlights.heading: Frontend System
points: Built with React + Vite with advanced animations
Performance optimization: lazy loading, code splitting, asset optimization

highlights.heading: Backend & Database
points: Designed 18+ database tables with Row-Level Security (RLS)
Stored procedures for rate limiting, analytics, and data aggregation

title: AI Code Editor — VS Code Extension
description: An AI-powered VS Code extension that automates development workflows using intelligent agents with a multi-agent architecture.

highlights.heading: Multi-Agent Architecture
points: Debugger → detects and fixes issues automatically

title: Taliyo Marketplace
description: A full-stack marketplace platform with separate systems for consumers and admins. Dual-app architecture with consumer app and admin dashboard.

title: Routiq — Life Management System
description: A personal productivity platform integrating Health, Fitness, Work, and Analytics into one cohesive system. React SPA with Zustand state management.
